ei.title: Automatic Dietary Responses to Food Cues
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Dietary behaviors are, in large part, the consequence of automatic responses to a particular situation with food, many of which lead to increased caloric consumption and poor dietary choices. Individuals are subject to inherent cognitive limitations and mostly lack the capacity to consistently recognize, ignore, or resist contextual cues that encourage eating. Take, for example, going to the movies. For many, a night at the movies also means sharing popcorn, candy, and soda. People often cannot resist this learned indulgence and are encouraged by the environment to eat a particular food. Another example is eating potato chips or peanuts that have been set out during a friendly card game or conversation with others. Individuals often consume snacks not because they are hungry, but because they are prompted by the social environment, which encourages them to eat. Similarly, grocery stores and restaurants have discovered the profits in suggestive selling, a sales technique where the customer is encouraged to make an additional purchase by taking advantage of a two-for-one sale or special discount. Grocery stores often use placement of items to encourage impulse buying.

questions.passage: People often cannot resist this learned indulgence and are __________ (encourage) by the environment to eat a particular food.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 수동태 구문 'are encouraged by the environment'에서 과거분사 필요. 사람들이 환경에 의해 '장려되는' 것이므로 수동의 과거분사 encouraged가 적절

questions.passage: Individuals are subject to inherent cognitive limitations and mostly lack the capacity to consistently recognize, ignore, or resist __________ (context) cues that encourage eating.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 명사 cues를 수식하는 형용사가 필요. '맥락적' 단서라는 의미이므로 context(명사)에 -ual 접미사를 붙인 contextual(형용사)이 정답

questions.passage: Dietary behaviors are, in large part, the consequence of automatic responses to a particular situation with food, many of which lead to increased caloric consumption and poor dietary choices. Individuals are subject to inherent cognitive limitations and mostly lack the capacity to consistently recognize, ignore, or resist __________ that encourage eating. Take, for example, going to the movies. For many, a night at the movies also means sharing popcorn, candy, and soda. People often cannot resist this learned indulgence and are encouraged by the environment to eat a particular food. Another example is eating potato chips or peanuts that have been set out during a friendly card game or conversation with others. Individuals often consume snacks not because they are hungry, but because they are prompted by the social environment, which encourages them to eat. Similarly, grocery stores and restaurants have discovered the profits in suggestive selling, a sales technique where the customer is encouraged to make an additional purchase by taking advantage of a two-for-one sale or special discount. Grocery stores often use placement of items to encourage impulse buying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ④ caloric consumption: '칼로리 섭취'는 저항 대상이 아닌 결과
❌ ② dietary behaviors: '식이 행동'은 저항 대상이 아닌 전체 주제
❌ ③ cognitive limitations: '인지적 한계'는 저항 대상이 아닌 원인
✅ ① contextual cues: 먹도록 장려하는 '맥락적 단서'를 저항한다는 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: contextual cues = 맥락적 단서 (환경에서 오는 식사 유발 신호)
